resources.string: "Capture sounds is a switch in the main menu, independent of vibration. The watch plays a shutter click for photos and bursts and cues for video start, pause, resume and stop. Feedback follows confirmed camera actions; each saved burst frame gives a short vibration and shutter animation. Returning to the app does not replay earlier captures. System sound settings apply. Burst interval defaults to 200 ms after the previous photo is saved; exposure and processing take additional time. Quick camera icons and the bezel no longer show Saved; settings pages still do."
